interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.56.0 adds three Python stdlib-only evaluation-rigor, manifest-integrity, coverage-matrix, and silent-noop-guard patterns selectively adapted from ai3inc/foldboost (commit ff7ad2208c, Apache-2.0): pre-registered evaluation plans with immutable frozen_core_sha256 seals and dual-verdict post-hoc amendment disclosure (scripts/verify_eval_plan.py), self-verifying manifest_sha256 seals and structured near_misses drift diagnostics in vault_install_state.py plus a read-only host/OS/adapter capability coverage matrix (vault_coverage_matrix.py and vault_doctor --coverage), and opt-in treatment activation / control zero-leakage silent no-op audits (scripts/eval_activation.py, exit 70, wired into evaluate_retrieval_backends.py and evaluate_tool_matrix.py via --check-activation). Retained from v0.55.0: verification-date staleness warnings (checked-at-stale, review-by-passed), alias-collision lint, URL query-parameter credential inspection (egress-url-secret), cloud-sync awareness and capability summaries (vault_cloud_sync.py), ADR invalidation triggers, and conclusion-reversal audit guidance. Retained from v0.54.0 and v0.54.1: invisible Unicode smuggling/Default_Ignorable stripping, UTF-8 BOM cleanup/guard, POSIX backup directory fsync, hook-wiring auditing (vault_hook_wiring.py), install-state tracking (vault_install_state.py), static CI hygiene tests, and scripts/verify_release_claims.py. No new runtime dependencies; Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. The seven certificate-bound checker files remain byte-identical from v0.55.0 through v0.56.0; when upgrading from v0.54.1 or earlier where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
